🌶️ SPICY SMP · Custom 1.21.11 · Java + Bedrock

Build without losing it. Fight when you want to.

⛏️ Mining and farming upgrades that stack the longer you play.

🏆 Server-wide event every hour. Live top 3 on the scoreboard.

👥 Teams, guilds, marriage, pets, cosmetics.

🗳️ Vote for claim flight and crate keys.
